args: const p = new MyPromise((resolve) => resolve(Promise.resolve("native"))); await wait(); return [p.state, p.value];
const p = new MyPromise((r) => r(1)).then((n) => new MyPromise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5, n + 1))); await wait(20); return p.value;
const p = new MyPromise((resolve) => resolve({ then(ok) { ok("from then"); } })); await wait(); return p.value;
const p = new MyPromise((resolve) => resolve({ then(ok, no) { no("refused"); } })); await wait(); return [p.state, p.value];
const p = new MyPromise((res) => res({ then() { throw new Error("bad then"); } })); await wait(); return p.value.message;
const p = new MyPromise((res, rej) => { res({ then: (ok) => setTimeout(ok, 5, 1) }); rej(2); }); await wait(20); return p.value;
const p = new MyPromise((res) => setTimeout(() => res(p), 0)); await wait(10); return [p.state, p.value instanceof TypeError];
const p = new MyPromise((res, rej) => rej("no")).catch((r) => "handled " + r); await wait(); return p.value;
const s = []; const p = new MyPromise((res) => res(7)).finally((...a) => s.push(a.length)); await wait(); return [s, p.value];
const p = new MyPromise((res, rej) => rej("no")).finally(() => {}); await wait(); return [p.state, p.value];
const p = new MyPromise((res) => res(1)).finally(() => { throw new Error("oops"); }); await wait(); return p.value.message;
